item.title: The Book of Masks: A 1920s Art Nouveau bestiary for roleplaying games
item.description: Arcane Canvas has launched The Book of Masks on Kickstarter. This trilogy of 1920s Art Nouveau hardcovers doubles as a system-neutral bestiary for roleplaying games.

item.title: D&D 5.5e is official: Has Wizards of the Coast just opened the door to 6th Edition?
item.description: Wizards of the Coast officially adopts the "5.5e" label for D&D 2024. Is this a marketing surrender or the first step toward D&D 6.0? Explore the 2026 roadmap featuring Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.

item.title: Check out the first trailer for The Handmaid’s Tale spinoff ‘The Testaments’
item.description: Hulu dropped an exciting first trailer for The Testaments earlier today, picking up the story five years after The Handmaid's Tale, and following a group of young women - including Hannah - in a disturbing coming-of-age tale.

item.title: Resistance mobilises: Modiphius announces official Wolfenstein roleplaying game
item.description: Modiphius announces Wolfenstein: The Tabletop Roleplaying Game. Join the resistance in a brutal alternate history using an updated 2d20 system.

item.title: Dungeons & Dragons pivots to seasonal model as Halo veteran Dan Ayoub takes charge
item.description: Wizards of the Coast unveils a new "seasonal" roadmap for D&D in 2026. Discover how the "Ayoub Doctrine" is transforming tabletop gaming into a live-service experience.

item.title: The design challenge of TAVERS: Turning surreal art into a tabletop experience
item.description: Meow Wolf enters the tabletop world with TAVERS, a surreal mystery RPG that raised $100k in 24 hours. Explore dimension-bending mechanics from Exalted Funeral.

item.title: Good Society: Regency Romance and Ruin
item.description: Create your own Regency romance or scandal with the Good Society RPG bundle. Get the complete first edition for $17.95 ahead of the upcoming 2E Kickstarter from Storybrewers.

item.title: Cardyhedron Fold: The magnetic tri-fold spinner dice for roleplaying games
item.description: SmokyCreation brings the Cardyhedron Fold to Kickstarter. This magnetic tri-fold spinner device replaces traditional polyhedrals with smooth micro ball bearing dials.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #351
item.description: Dungeons & Dragons confirms the 2024 rules as version 5.5, while a major Fan Expo heads to London. Plus, Sirius Dice lands a Lord of the Rings licence, Modiphius announces a Wolfenstein roleplaying game, and the UK Ministry of Defence turns to world-building.

item.title: Audio EXP #324: D&D at The O2, Wolfenstein Roleplaying, and MoD Sci-Fi
item.description: Audio EXP 324 covers the Ministry of Defence using sci-fi writers to plan the future, D&D moving to a seasonal model, and the new Good Society bundle.
